preconditions.description: The number of rows M must be between 1 and 2 inclusive.
The number of columns N must be between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The maximum value K for the integers in the matrix must be between 1 and 100,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be the expected number of strongly connected components represented as P * Q^-1 modulo 998244353.
